name: BORICUM ACIDUM
urinary_symptoms: Climacteric flushings (Lach; Amyl nit). Vagina cold, as if packed with ice. Frequent urination with burning and tenesmus.
skin_symptoms: Multiform erythema of trunk and upper extremities. Śdema around eyes. Exfoliating dermatitis. Śdema of tissues around eyes.

source.title: BORICUM ACIDUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
